The public JPEG API headers in this directory are from the Independent JPEG
Group libjpeg 9e API. They are used for the target's ABI-matched
`libjpeg.so.9` runtime when the sysroot does not provide `jpeglib.h`.

Copyright notices and the Independent JPEG Group license terms
are retained in the headers. The runtime library is supplied by the target
Linux image or by the host development environment.
